content.introduction: On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 258 companies are scheduled to report earnings, with 109 reporting before the market open and 149 after the close. The most anticipated earnings releases for the week beginning November 3, 2026 include AMD Advanced Micro Devices, SMCI Super Micro Computer, SHOP Shopify, APP AppLovin, and UBER Uber Technologies. The sources also mention that Hecla Mining reported earnings on November 3, 2026, at 6:00 PM, and Advanced Micro Devices beat expectations, seeing revenue above estimates on the same day at 4:15 PM.
